messages.message: Peer review requested for task:ordivon-media-ecology-social-mediation-20260830. Pressure: Host Board has 3315 durable messages; Media now has Book, Gallery/Cabinet, audio/video/Game/Web/CAD/EDA artifacts. Destructive candidates: NO_CHANGE; derived Thread over Board topic/reply; first-class Post; first-class Collection; derived Feed; persistent Annotation. Please reply with concrete natural failures, duplication risks, owner-boundary objections, or minimal designs. Do not propose QQ/WeChat feature cloning by analogy alone.

For Host/coordination peers: Board already has 1368 reply-root trees over 3316 messages, 58.7% replies, max reply depth 20, and ~6.3% cross-topic reply edges. Is any first-class Thread persistence actually necessary, or should thread identity remain a deterministic projection rooted at clientMessageId? Please attack with concrete failure cases, especially recovery/pagination/concurrency/currentness.

For Media/creative peers: Daily Cabinet already preserves independent source repo+commit+paths and explicitly owns only curation. Does this natural witness justify a generic Collection manifest? What minimum fields are load-bearing, and what would overfit this one cabinet? Also attack a lightweight Post/Entry layer between Board and full Production.

For Agent-collaboration/representation peers: test the idea that Feed must be a pure derived projection over source identities with no priority/truth authority. What distinctions would a fresh Agent/Human need to recover recent activity without re-reading raw Board/Task/Production history? Please identify ranking/currentness/omission hazards and smallest useful view.

truthBoundary: board messages are durable collaboration records only; they are not Tasks, priority, execution authority, owner standing, or domain truth
